questions.text: How does UAP Document 301 define the guarantee bond?

options.text: Security guaranteeing the quality of materials, installed equipment, and workmanship performed by the contractor
Security guaranteeing bidder acceptance of a future contract
Insurance for foreign architects under a temporary permit
A payment bond for all supplier invoices only

questions.rationale: Correct because it follows UAP Document 301 line 493. The other options change the document, party, timing, amount, or legal effect stated in the checked local source.
questions.explanation: Wrongly conflates the two; the distinction determines whether Contractor or Architect bears responsibility. Wrongly assumes blanket execution coverage; excluded execution defects (Owner-caused, wear) are still excluded. Wrongly treats both as covered; design defects are explicitly excluded from Guarantee Bond. Guarantee Bond covers Contractor's execution defects but excludes design defects, which are Architect's responsibility. Guarantee Bond scope: covers execution defects; excludes design defects (Architect's responsibility).
